"If, for some reason, the formation pressure is greater than the borehole pressure an influx of fluid into the borehole (known as a kick) will occur." [KB2]

"The logarithmic derivative was devised to be a sensitive indicator of radial flow through the derivative plateau on a log-log diagnostic plot." [KB1] "in the period of wellbore storage dominated flow, the pressure and its logarithmic derivative overlay on the unit slope diagonal (self-similarity)." [KB3]
